prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design Sylph as a remote coding Workspace where Workspaces are routes through intent, change, test, preview, and release; transfers reveal exactly where attention is needed.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed 1600x1000 desktop application, no device frame and no marketing page.
Structure: Compact Sylph chrome at top. A disciplined Workspace route line runs horizontally beneath it with literal stations Intent, Editing, Checks, Preview, Review and multiple small parallel branch lines. A narrow left corridor selector lists Workspaces. The center is a dense but calm agent conversation plus file/diff surface. A large live browser preview dominates the right as the principal interchange, with browser-control state attached to its station. Do not shrink the whole map into a decorative overview.
Content: Selected Workspace Checkout restoration, repository folkhero-web, agent task Polish the onboarding flow; other routes Fix OAuth callback and Upgrade billing webhook; browser preview shows a tasteful SaaS onboarding screen; file src/routes/onboarding.tsx; states Running, Waiting, Ready; status Browser checks 4/4 and Agent controlling browser.
Style/medium: Production-grade developer tool fully committed to a midnight enamel metropolitan transit diagram. Humanist transit sans, fixed-size labels, 45 and 90 degree line discipline, porcelain station ticks, beveled enamel panels. All product controls and states follow this grammar.
Composition/framing: The browser preview is the largest single surface and active destination. The selected Workspace corridor burns brightest while transfer context remains. Use seams and route geometry rather than rounded bento cards.
Lighting/mood: A precise midnight station mural under clean task lighting, serious and highly legible.
Color palette: midnight enamel #081230, porcelain white #F7F6F0, scarlet #E21D2D, cobalt #1E5BFF, amber #FFC20E, green #22B14C. Colored lines encode state and route, not decoration.
Materials/textures: enamel ground, porcelain ticks, screen glass, line ink.
Text (verbatim where shown): Sylph, Checkout restoration, folkhero-web, Polish the onboarding flow, Intent, Editing, Checks, Preview, Review, Fix OAuth callback, Upgrade billing webhook, src/routes/onboarding.tsx, Browser checks 4/4, Agent controlling browser.
Constraints: Must read instantly as an IDE-like product Workspace for code, agent conversation, browser preview, skills and testing. Dense but uncluttered. Accessible contrast. No invented customers or metrics.
Avoid: subway illustration, literal trains, decorative spaghetti map, generic dark IDE, equal-weight cards, glowing neon edges, excessive pills, glassmorphism, marketing page, device frame, tiny illegible text.
